task: Implement cache_result for the API cache without using CDN cache semantics.

candidate_memories.content: API cache cache_result stores a computed value keyed by user ID and request hash for 60 seconds.
API cache operates in the application layer; keys include the authentication scope.
API cache entries are invalidated by user action events, not by HTTP cache-control headers.
When cache_result spans API and CDN layers, confirm the invalidation model before implementing.
CDN cache: cache_result stores an HTTP response keyed by URL with cache-control header TTL.
candidate_memories.notes: negative_transfer: CDN cache semantics (URL keys, HTTP headers) are wrong for the auth-scoped API cache

candidate_memories.content: Old architecture note says caching layers should be unified under a single cache_result API.
